description_excerpt: • Perform testing and evaluation of telecommunication, electronic, and ICT products in accordance with QCVN, TCVN, and international standards. • Set up test environments, prepare Equipment Under Test (EUT), and operate testing and measurement equipment according to test plans. • Collect and record test data, take photographs, analyze results, and prepare test reports. • Ensure all testing activities fully comply with established procedures, test methods, and technical requirements. • Research and stay updated on new standards and technical regulations; propose improvements and optimization…
